name: Ulysses
tagline: The core loop is small enough for a capable coding agent to produce a useful local version in one sitting. For Ulysses, write in a focused Markdown library, organize sheets, set goals, and export polished documents. The hard boundary is native apple polish, icloud sync, mobile apps, and publishing integrations, plus polish, integrations, and proprietary language models.
